name: Penumbra Prism Reef
core_rationale: Tenth floating basalt-and-crystal reef of Continent 03 where Vesper's half-shadowed gravity lens bends twilight starlight into shimmering penumbral coral arches.
local_conflict: Penumbral glass-manta rays and crystal-shelled hermit constructs drift between the half-lit prism arches.

mystery_hook.in_world_rumor: Star-navigators whisper that Penumbra Prism Reef casts two simultaneous shadows—one pointing toward the Zenith Crown and one pointing into the abyssal whirlpool below.
mystery_hook.visual_silhouette: A floating reef of smoky violet prism-spires and inverted silver coral arches along the outer twilight ring.
mystery_hook.unanswered_question: What twilight observatory town anchors the half-shadowed arches of Penumbra Prism Reef?

causal_continuity.evidence: Directly inherits god-vesper-dream-eater and scar-vesper-crater along the outer penumbral ring of Continent 03.

fantasy_and_wonder.evidence: Floating smoky-violet prism reefs and inverted silver coral arches bending twilight starlight.

character_scale_consistency.evidence: Specifies 12.5m prism-bridge walkways, 0.58m astrolabe consoles, and 0.14m basalt risers tailored to 1.05m characters.

spatial_and_ecological_consistency.evidence: Draft status: seeds Penumbra Refraction Causeway at [0, 1] while the central town, dungeon, and northern arch remain queued.

intentional_mystery_discipline.evidence: Maintains Penumbra Refraction Causeway in Mystery status with zero filler maps.
